nextjs.name: Next.js
nextjs.description: Next.js is a React framework that enables server-rendered (SSR), static-generated (SSG), and hybrid web applications. Perfect for SEO, high performance, and rapid development.

typescript.name: TypeScript
typescript.description: TypeScript is a superset of JavaScript that adds static typing features. Helps catch errors early and makes code more maintainable, especially in large projects.

clerk.name: Clerk
clerk.description: Clerk is a ready-to-use authentication service for modern applications. Provides login, registration, session management, and security without having to set up your own backend.

tailwind.name: Tailwind CSS
tailwind.description: Tailwind CSS is a utility-first CSS framework that allows styling directly in HTML markup. Highly flexible, perfect for custom designs, and very fast to develop.

html.name: HTML
html.description: HTML (HyperText Markup Language) is the foundation of every web page. Used to define content structure such as headings, paragraphs, images, and forms.

css.name: CSS
css.description: CSS (Cascading Style Sheets) is used to control the appearance and layout of web pages. Separates content (HTML) from design, enabling visual consistency and responsiveness.

javascript.name: JavaScript
javascript.description: JavaScript is the core programming language of the web that makes web pages interactive and dynamic. Can run in browsers (frontend) or servers (Node.js), making it versatile and essential to master.

react.name: React
react.description: React is a JavaScript library for building interactive and dynamic user interfaces. Developed by Facebook, React uses component-based concepts and virtual DOM for optimal performance. Very popular with an extensive ecosystem for modern web application development.

nodejs.name: Node.js
nodejs.description: JavaScript runtime built on Chrome:s V8 engine to execute JavaScript on the server with an efficient event-driven non-blocking I/O model.

express.name: Express.js
express.description: Minimalist and flexible Node.js web application framework providing a robust set of features for building modular web APIs and backends.

postgresql.name: PostgreSQL
postgresql.description: Enterprise-grade open-source relational database supporting complex SQL queries, high data integrity, and ACID transactional reliability.

mysql.name: MySQL
mysql.description: Popular, fast, and dependable relational database management system widely adopted across modern web applications.

prisma.name: Prisma ORM
prisma.description: Next-generation ORM for Node.js and TypeScript simplifying database workflows with declarative schemas and complete type safety.

restapi.name: RESTful API
restapi.description: Architectural style for stateless, structured, and standardized HTTP communication enforcing clean client-server separation.
features: Standard HTTP methods (GET, POST, PUT, DELETE)
Strict separation of client and server

aiagent.name: AI Agent Integration
aiagent.description: Autonomous agent workflows and LLM integrations accelerating development lifecycles, structured data extraction, and contextual reasoning.

git.name: Git & GitHub
git.description: Distributed version control system for tracking source code changes, team collaboration, and structured branching workflows.

docker.name: Docker
docker.description: Containerization platform to package applications and their dependencies into lightweight, isolated containers that run reliably anywhere.

postman.name: Postman
postman.description: Collaborative API development platform to design, test, document, and monitor RESTful APIs with automated test suites.

vercel.name: Vercel
vercel.description: Frontend cloud platform optimized for deploying React and Next.js applications seamlessly with edge routing and automatic CI/CD.

sanity.name: Sanity CMS
sanity.description: Cloud-hosted structured content platform with a customizable real-time studio and fast APIs for modern web content management.
